summary: Sabbatical return: reprovision existing laptop, re-enable accounts, and confirm license allocation
description:
Issue summary: Employee returning from a 6-month sabbatical requests reuse of previous company laptop and reinstatement of all corporate accounts. HR submitted a rehire notice but offboarding ran automated deprovisioning (Okta disable, MDM wipe, license release).

Impact: Blocked access to Slack, Jira, CI/CD, and internal clusters until accounts and device are re-provisioned. The returning engineer (contract: full-time) needs access for an upcoming on-call rotation starting 2026-03-15. Delays could impact coverage and project sprints.

Environment: Internal (corp Okta + Jamf MDM), device: MacBook Pro 14" (serial SDF1234XYZ) previously issued and inventoried in Asset DB.

Requested outcome: 1) Verify device integrity and re-enroll in MDM without issuing a new laptop if safe. 2) Re-enable Okta account and re-provision SSO apps (Slack, Atlassian, Google Workspace, AWS/GCP IAM). 3) Re-assign required licenses (JetBrains, Sentry, Datadog) and confirm access to Dedicated cluster role bindings. 4) Confirm MFA and device attestation requirements are met and document any policy exceptions needed for reactivation.
steps_to_reproduce: 1. HR rehire form submitted on 2026-03-01 (ticket HR-8765).
2. Automated offboarding previously ran on 2025-09-28: Okta profile disabled, Jamf signal sent to wipe device, licenses released from seat pool.
3. Returning user attempted to sign in to Slack and got SSO error: 'account_disabled'.
4. User cannot access the laptop due to FileVault key escrow removal and has not yet been sent a new device.
impact: Medium — returning engineer cannot perform critical on-call tasks; coverage risk for 2026-03-15 shift. No customer-facing outage expected but internal operational risk is elevated.
investigation_notes:
- Confirmed Okta shows account status: OFFBOARDED (disabled) and deprovision timestamp 2025-09-28.
- Asset DB shows serial SDF1234XYZ assigned to user until 2025-09-27 and marked 'wiped'. Last MDM check-in record: 2025-09-27.
- HR indicates employee is full-time rehire and eligible to reacquire previous device if it passed secure wipe and hardware check. HR provided rehire approval email chain.
- Security policy requires device attestation and MDM enrollment before granting SSO tokens.
- Preliminary Jamf logs show device accepted wipe command; need to confirm physical custody and FileVault escrow status.
comments: 2026-03-02 10:12 - Sofia Alvarez: Created ticket after HR rehire notification. Marking as P2 due to on-call coverage requirement.
2026-03-03 09:45 - Arjun Patel: Reached out to IT Asset team to locate the physical device and confirm purchase/warranty status.

2026-03-04 14:22 - Priya Menon (IT Asset): Device located in storage locker B-7, serial SDF1234XYZ. Received inventory inspection; battery and storage health ok. Recommending re-enroll rather than RMA.

2026-03-05 11:03 - Security (Marcus Li): Need to verify FileVault escrow and ensure OS image matches approved baseline before re-enroll. Suggest remote wipe and re-enroll then re-key via escrow if user can pass identity checks.
2026-03-07 16:20 - Arjun Patel: Requested temporary 48-hour exception to skip fresh laptop issuance if security clears MDM re-enroll path. Noted upcoming on-call date (2026-03-15).
2026-03-09 08:55 - HR (Leah Kim): Confirmed employment reactivation and authorized reuse of prior hardware if device passes security checklist.
workaround: Short-term: Assign on-call buddy to cover the returning engineer's rotation. Create temporary CSC account for Slack and email forwarding if immediate access cannot be restored. However this is suboptimal for privileged infra access.
resolution: In progress — awaiting Security team's FileVault escrow verification and MDM re-enroll confirmation. Plan: 1) IT Asset will perform one-time secure check and hand device to returning employee; 2) Security will re-provision escrow key and validate OS baseline; 3) Okta team will re-activate account and re-sync app entitlements; 4) Licensing team will reallocate seats as needed. Will document any policy exception for future reinstatements.
follow_up_tasks: Security: Confirm FileVault escrow recovery and attest OS image (owner: Marcus Li).
IT Asset: Complete physical checklist and transfer device custody (owner: Priya Menon).
Okta team: Re-enable account and assign groups per role (owner: Arjun Patel).
Licensing: Reassign JetBrains and Datadog seats and confirm seat counts (owner: FinanceOps).
notes_for_policy_team: Question: Should we create a streamlined 'return from sabbatical' runbook that allows MDM re-enroll + escrow rekey path to avoid issuing new hardware when device passes checks? Current guidance forces RMA in majority of cases which increases costs. Requesting policy clarification or a temporary exception precedent.
expected_sla: First response within 24 hours; full reprovisioning target by 2026-03-12 to meet on-call date.
estimated_effort: 4-8 hours (cross-team coordination: Security, IT Asset, Okta, Licensing)
additional_context: Returning engineer previously had Dedicated cluster RBAC binding 'infra-engineer-prod' which must be reviewed before re-granting. Any change in role or onboarding checklist should be captured in HR rehire form to avoid missing entitlements.
